name: Scarlet Monastery Armory: Herod's Door opens with a click and stays open (#12067)
contract: #12067: Herod's Door (101854, spawn 32250) was spawned open (rev_20261002_20) and keyless (rev_20261003_10). A click closed it, and since the door has no auto-close time it was then stuck closed: the gameobject stays activated after its first use and ignores later clicks until it resets. Every other keyless dungeon door spawns closed and opens on the first click for good; Herod's Door now spawns closed too.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the Armory is spawned
Herod's Door starts closed, like the other keyless dungeon doors
One click opens it without the Scarlet Key
DISCRIMINATING: a second click does not close it again
